cases.title: Collect dishes wrong-next conflict
cases.research_question: When active_chunk_id says collect_dishes but next_chunk fields incorrectly point to wipe_surface, does move_on follow the active carrier's legal next step instead of the wrong next field?
expected_behavior: Assistant treats collect_dishes as active and advances exactly one legal step to stack_papers.
forbidden_behavior: Assistant follows the wrong next_chunk fields to wipe_surface or skips stack_papers.

cases.title: Next-only no-active negative control
cases.research_question: Without any active_chunk or route_sequence field, do next_chunk fields alone fail to establish legal active state?
expected_behavior: Assistant should not confidently claim legal advancement from a known active chunk because no active position was provided.
forbidden_behavior: Assistant treats next_chunk_id or next_chunk_label alone as proof of legal movement and claims a clean move_on to stack_papers.
